svg.text: ROUND 363 · 🏆 740-VECTOR MILESTONE · CORPORATE TRAVEL & EXPENSE (SAP CONCUR / NAVAN / RAMP / FCPA COMPLIANCE)
Corporate Travel & Expense (SAP Concur/Navan), Virtual Cards & FCPA Anti-Bribery AI Security Guide
Exec M&A Itinerary & Ethics Audit Air-Gap + PEP Gift Cap & L3 Receipt Lock vs. Folio OCR Injection & TMC Wire Fraud (BRK-735 / BRK-736)
🚨 1. Top 3 Corporate T&E & FCPA Attack Surfaces
① Receipt/Folio PDF Injection & Exec Itinerary Leak (BRK-735)
• Adversarial prompt inside a hotel folio or restaurant receipt PDF
coerces T&E Audit Agent into reading restricted-budget
• Exfiltrates confidential executive M&A flight manifests, internal
FCPA whistleblower investigation dockets & PEP watchlists
② FCPA Foreign Official Bribe Laundering & Double-Dipping
• Mutates business-result to reclassify luxury gifts/hospitality
for Foreign Public Officials (PEPs / HCPs) as "Internal Training"
• Bypasses duplicate-receipt hash checks on corporate card feeds
• Impact: DOJ FCPA / UK Bribery Act / Sunshine Act criminal fines
③ Spoofed TMC Lodge-Card & VAT Reclaim Wire Fraud (BRK-736)
• Forged Travel Management Company (Amex GBT / BCD) central
lodge-card statement or VAT reclaim agency notice swaps IBAN
• Initiates unauthorized $5,450 settlement wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Corporate travel settlement diversion & out-of-pocket theft
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Corporate T&E Defense Architecture
Gate 1: Folio OCR Sanitization & Typed L3 Card Slots
• Strips free-text expense justifications from receipt PDFs; extracts
typed slots (Merchant MCC, Visa/Amex L3 Txn ID, Attendee NPI/PEP ID)
• Strictly tags untrusted=True, lane="attack"
Gate 2: Executive M&A Itinerary & Ethics Audit Air-Gap
• Isolates executive M&A travel manifests, whistleblower ethics
investigations, and FCPA investigation dockets in restricted-budget
• Enforced via record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic FCPA PEP Cap & L3 Duplicate-Hash Lock
• Enforces per-attendee PEP/HCP meal caps, MCC category blocks,
and L3 card-feed vs. out-of-pocket duplicate-hash checks in code
• Enforced via untrusted-write blocking tainted GL reclassifications
Gate 4: Immutable HRIS Payroll & TMC Settlement Registry
• Locks employee payroll & TMC lodge-card accounts in trust-registry
(tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment)
📊 3. Architecture Selection & Benchmark Results
Head-to-Head Corporate T&E Security Options:
A. Deterministic T&E Broker + M&A Air-Gap + FCPA Lock (🏆)
✓ 100% Block on BRK-735/736 | DOJ FCPA & Sunshine Act Ready
B. Native SAP Concur / Navan / Ramp Audit Rules
⚠ Vulnerable when AI expense auditor is hijacked by folio PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Prompt Shields / Bedrock Guardrails)
⚠ Blind to Visa L3 line-items, NPI/PEP registries & receipt hashes
D. Manual 10% Sample Expense Audits by T&E Clerks
✕ Misses 90% of split-ticket FCPA bribes & AI-generated fake receipts
🧪 Pytest Deterministic Regression (Round 363 · 740 Vectors!):
• Baseline Policy: PEP bribe laundered, M&A leaked & wire allowed ❌
• Hardened Policy: All 5 deterministic gates blocked 100% ✅
- record-owner: Blocks reading exec M&A itineraries (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks PEP GL reclassification & duplicate bypass
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks FCPA investigation exfiltration
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks TMC/payroll registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,450 spoofed TMC wire
🚀 Architect Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestones (Round 363 · 🏆 740 Interactive Attack Vectors Milestone!)
✅ 1. Exec M&A Itinerary & Ethics Audit Air-Gap: Isolate CEO M&A flight logs & FCPA dockets from T&E receipt OCR agents
✅ 2. Deterministic FCPA/Sunshine Act & L3 Card Match: Enforce PEP/HCP meal caps and cross-card duplicate receipt hashing
✅ 3. Immutable HRIS Payroll & TMC Registry: Route employee reimbursements strictly to HRIS payroll accounts; lock trust-registry
📊 Verified Totals: 754 Scenarios (751 Risk + 3 Benign) | 838 Pytest Checks | 1,574 Assertions | 🏆 740 Vectors | 363 Bilingual FAQs (182 SA Guides) | BRK-735/736
